reuse.why: Introduces and routes all six providers through a shared linkBankSyncAccount, but re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset for displaced holders and copies the Akahu downloader for Fintegra instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: The per-provider link bodies are consolidated, but the holder unlink duplicates unlinkAccount's updateAccount field set and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Everything stays in accounts/app.ts and sync.ts where the tree keeps it, though the link rules sit in a separate assertBankAccountNotLinked that each provider must call before linkBankSyncAccount, and that 'assert' also performs the unlink writes.

scope.why: Changes follow the four steps; the small desktop-client additions only register the new provider name and flag map entry.

maintainability.why: The shared link function is a real improvement, but rules live outside it (six repeated assert + findOrCreateBank preambles), a validation helper mutates other accounts, and two copied blocks remain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts resets holder accounts with its own db.updateAccount instead of sharing unlinkAccount's reset; downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts copies the Akahu downloader

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains fileId and tables parameters for per-provider variations; assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink with a branch that unlinks holders; every provider still calls assertBankAccountNotLinked separately before the shared link function rather than the rules living in it
